The latest Economist/YouGov poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adult citizens from August 28 to 31, 2026. Its overall sample had a margin of error of 3.5 percentage points.

Respondents were asked whether they approved or disapproved of the way Trump was handling his job as president. Among those aged 30 to 44, the 27 percent approval figure was outweighed by 70 percent disapproval. [...] That negative 43-point balance supersedes the negative 39 recorded in June and marks an eight-point fall from July's negative 35.

results.content: The political implications are evident in congressional preference. Democrats now lead Republicans 46 to 40 percent among registered voters for the 2026 House elections, the largest Democratic advantage in any Economist/YouGov poll since February 2026. Among voters who strongly disapprove of Trump—now half the population—82 percent say they would vote for a Democratic congressional candidate compared to 3 percent who would vote Republican. [...] President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 33 percent in the latest Economist/YouGov poll, marking his lowest approval in YouGov tracking across both his first and second terms.
